1 Scientific Literature.Title: Multi-fiber reinforced ettringite-based composites from industrial side streams
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Hoang Nguyen, Malena Staudacher, Paivo Kinnunen, Valter Carvelli, Mirja Illikainen
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Evaluate mechanical properties of hybrid and mono PP/PVA fiber reinforced ettringite-based binders from ladle slag and gypsum (LSG, LSG-FA) and rank 12 mixtures by performance, cost, embodied energy and CO2.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Fibers raised compressive strength up to 130% over plain LSG; composites show strain-hardening with multiple cracks. FBC fly ash weakened LSG by up to 60% in compression. PP multifilament fiber reinforced LSG ranked best overall. LSG/LSG-FA composites ~147 kg CO2-eq/m3, about 4x lower than ECC M45.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Ladle slag used as main binder (98% by-product binder), not partial cement replacement.

2 Feedstock Chemistry.Source/Origin: SSAB Europe Oy (Finland), collected at slag cooling pit, naturally weathered
2 Feedstock Chemistry.Notes: Table 1, XRF PANalytical Omnian Axiosmax 4 kV. Others 4.66%. Free CaO zero per EN 450-1 method. Phases: C3A, mayenite C12A7, gamma-C2S, periclase. Gypsum: CaO 41.40, SO3 53.75. FBC-FA: CaO 12.0, SiO2 30.8, Al2O3 15.1, Fe2O3 26.7.

3 Processing.Initial_Material_Form: Weathered ladle slag from cooling pit
